description: Keeps GitHub Actions and uv pins in workflows current on gumnut-ai/photos-typescript-staging. gumnut-ai/photos-sdk-typescript gets these updates when staging is promoted, so Renovate changes nothing outside gumnut-ai/photos-typescript-staging.

packageRules.description: Workflow updates change no SDK code, so their commits cut no release
Only gumnut-ai/photos-typescript-staging takes updates; gumnut-ai/photos-sdk-typescript gets them by promotion
